comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Network — clients that follow redirects, accept URLs from input.' We detect SSRF via HTTP client calls but don't flag redirect-following as an escalation factor. Hackney, Tesla, and Req all support follow_redirects. When a tainted URL is passed with follow_redirects: true, an attacker can redirect to internal services. Flag as higher severity when follow_redirects is enabled. Severity: Medium escalation of existing SSRF. Note: related to catseye-0sm.

title: Elixir: detect redirect-following SSRF (HTTP clients with follow_redirects: true on tainted URLs)
